title: Chapter 523
paragraphs: Chapter 523
Episode 144. For a Friend (1)
All the portals in the Empire were closed.
The armies of the vassal states were spotted heading towards the Empire, both by land and sea.
Without a doubt, the Empire was preparing for war. A war with Hiran.
Boooong-!
A white dimensional gate formed in the front yard of Tikan, revealing the frog-like Mot.
Talris went to the Sword Emperor City as soon as he realized something was not normal. Due to the many dimensional travels in a short time, Mot seemed quite tired.
"Master Talris!"
As Jin and his companions approached, Talris shook his head as if bewildered.
"The Emperor has gone mad. He really seems to be going to attack the Sword Emperor City."
"Did you see Lord Ron?"

"He wasn't there. I couldn't hear any detailed information either. But the Sword Emperor City is completely poisoned... The war is inevitable. All the martial artists who follow Ron are also gathering at the Sword Emperor City."
A war between Hiran and the entire Empire.
Originally, Talris thought that as long as Ron was there, the result of that war would surely turn to Hiran's victory.
But now, having been to the Sword Emperor City himself, she couldn't be sure. It was not because she hadn't met Ron in person.
"There are surprisingly few families who have decided to help Hiran. I don't know whether the royal family has played some tricks, or Ron lost his reputation while I was unaware."
Jin knew the reason.
"Master Talris."
"Why?"
"You told me to let you know if something bad seems to happen at the Sword Emperor City. Could you tell me the reason?"
The Secret Palace had always remained neutral, but now it should rightfully be called Jin's ally.
However, the relationship with Hiran was not certain.
In fact, the Secret Palace had no need to intervene even if Hiran were to be destroyed. Precisely, it should not intervene. It would unnecessarily make the Empire an enemy.
So she should have revealed the fact that Ron was not in good health only after showing her stance to help the Sword Emperor City.
Talris shrugged her shoulders and looked at Jin's companions.
"Everyone, step out for a moment. I need to talk to my son-in-law."
His companions stepped aside.
"Son-in-law."
"Yes."
"Do you remember what I told you last time about the duty of the Secret Palace?"

"The Secret Palace has been neutral for most of the time, but it hasn't always been that way. We also made one vow when the first Palace Master was chosen by the Divine Sword Mambing and the selection of Mot.

The power of Mambing obtained by our Endorma clan is the same. In exchange for obtaining power that is excessive for a human, we received the mission to contribute to solving the anomalies of the world."
Jin recalled the story and nodded.
"The predecessors of the Secret Palace left a record that Hiran possesses one thing that could threaten the world."
The white stone.
That was the story.
It was Hiran's biggest secret, only passed down to the heads of families, but the Secret Palace had known about the existence of this stone long ago.

"Our Secret Palace assumes that the object that Hiran has is an object of the Witch Heluram. And as I said last time, preventing the disaster that Heluram brings is one of the typical duties of the Secret Palace."
"So, Master Talris, your main goal in this matter as the Palace Master is to prevent the danger that Hiran is harboring."
"That's right."
Talris answered nonchalantly.
Her words about fulfilling the duty of the Secret Palace could be interpreted in many ways.

'It's entirely plausible that Master Talris prioritizes dealing with the white stone over Hiran, but if you think about it... the moment the white stone reveals its danger, Master Talris could even attack Hiran.'
Right now, there's no way to know what state the white stone is in.
Also, it was not certain what choice Hiran would make when the situation reached its extreme.
Dante was a friend, but the leader of Hiran was not Dante, but Ron.
If Hiran is in the worst situation in this war.
If he could just protect his beloved grandson, Ron was a person who could use the power of the white stone.
'It doesn't seem like the royal family would covet something that's just that.'
'You're right.'

'I roughly understand. That stone is a dangerous object that should not be revealed to anyone in the world. So, the first head of Hiran who obtained that object tried to get rid of it and failed, I guess. Then, they left only the order to destroy it without revealing the identity of the object so that the next heads would not be greedy.'
'You deduced all that just by listening to my brief explanation? That's shocking.'
'It's even more shocking that not only all the past heads of Hiran, but even Lord Ron couldn't get rid of that stone. What kind of stone is it?'
The conversation about Dante and the white stone.
From that conversation, the danger of the white stone was already revealed.
It was the same from the actions of the emperor who tried to get the stone even by giving up Hiran.
'In case the stone threatens the world and Master Talris stands on the side to stop Hiran.'
"There's no way to stop it."
That's why Jin hesitated to inform Talris about Ron.
Seeing Jin silent for a while, Talris flashed a playful smile as if she knew everything.
"Son-in-law."
"Yes."
"I think I know what you're worried about. You're surprisingly easy to read."
"Yes, I'm worried. Whatever happens, I'll help Dante as a friend."
"Even if that leads to conflict with me?"
"Yes."
A heavy silence fell between the two.

"...Ron, that fool, might use Heluram's object to save his grandson. Because there's nothing more important to him than his grandson. But Jin, just as Dante Hiran is your friend, Ron Hiran is my companion."
Shiron, Ron, and Talris.
For the three of them, the closest people to a friend or a companion were each other.
Such is the life of the absolute beings. The higher you stand, the stronger power you gain, the deeper realm you enter.
People become lonely. They gained absolute power as the price for falling into the deepest loneliness.
Only those who entered that realm could understand each other.
However, just as stars disappear when they collide if they get too close, their relationship was no different.
If one of the three could encompass everyone, they would have become the most affectionate friends.
But Shiron, who could take on that role, was ascending to a higher and lonelier realm, losing his human emotions, and from then on, the three could not get closer.
The feeling of being companions still exists.
That's why Talris hoped that she wouldn't have to perform her duty, and if possible, she had the will to make the situation flow that way.

"So be a little more honest with me, tell me everything you know. We're discussing the worst-case scenario right now, but it's just a hypothesis, isn't it? We have power. The power to exclude the worst."
She felt sincere.
Also, realistically, Talris' ability was needed to help Hiran as quickly as possible.
The closure of all transport gates means that both the land and sea routes are blocked.
Jin was prepared to approach Sword Emperor City through the land and sea routes while fighting the imperial army, and he was confident he could break through without much difficulty.
But that would be too late.
"If Hiran can't hold on until then, instead of helping a friend, I would only end up antagonizing the empire.
Going quickly to fight together also means turning against the empire, but if we can lead the war to victory, it would have sufficient meaning.
Jin is a knight of Runkandel.
He planned to carry out this support without the permission of the proxy lord, Rosa, as a knight.
Then, he had to have results.
"And maybe, you and I are overthinking. Although there were fewer knights with the Hiran banner than I thought, if it's Ron..."
"Sir Ron... has not yet recovered from the injuries sustained during the Sword Emperor City terrorist attack."
Talris's pupils dilated.
"...What?"

"After fighting with the chief of Kinselo and getting injured, Sir Ron's condition has not improved at all. I don't know the exact situation, but it could be more serious than then. And only you, me, and five of Sir Ron's closest aides know this."
"Huh, I was aware that Ron hasn't been active externally since the Sword Emperor City terror attack... Are you saying it was because of that reason?"

"The reason the emperor is carrying out a purge, and the lack of knights standing with Hiran, are all due to that. Probably the people in the empire who need to know, know that Sir Ron is not normal."

"...Ron is deceptively skilled in trickery, so maybe he's doing this on purpose. Pretending to be sick to uproot Hiran's enemies at this chance, maybe even intending to deal with the emperor... Damn, the situation doesn't look good for that. Ron's not the type to seek power even by creating conflicts."
Whew, Talris sighed.
Hearing about Ron's condition, she couldn't help but worry more. It was only natural since she had been concerned about the risk of the white stone even when assuming he was healthy.
"I understand why Ron didn't meet me. Though we're friends, fundamentally I'm a stranger to Hiran, so he couldn't reveal his condition."
More than that, if it's the worst-case scenario, his condition might be so bad that he can't even move.
"Lady Talris."
"Speak."
"Please help me and my colleagues get to Sword Emperor City via the mote."
"Sure. But it's impossible right now. The mote is tired because I've just traveled a long distance. It needs time to recover."
Jin nodded his head.
"I need some time anyway. I have to gather my colleagues and subordinates, and also create a means to protect Tikan while it's completely drained of power."
Jin planned to pour all his efforts into Hiran.
